reading.workResult: Completed primary-source Deep Reading for all three run-date selected objects and produced three durable Reading Notes. Q-20260810-01 verified durable pending-input admission in resumable RunState, including serialized pending input, occurrence identity, guardrail/admission ordering, checkpointed accepted-response/tool progress, and the boundary of SDK-level exactly-once semantics. Q-20260810-02 verified OrchestraBench's controlled failure-injection design, three-tier recovery behavior, blind-retry failure on latent modes, cascade-radius depth scaling, the trusted-upstream policy assumption, the llm_noupstream ablation, and the paper's explicit external-validity limits. Q-20260810-03 verified the MCPServerManager race mechanism, manager-level lifecycle serialization, cancellation-shielded cleanup ownership, safe worker replacement, preserved cleanup failures, 10-second default lifecycle timeouts, and deterministic concurrency regression coverage. No Research Analysis or article drafting was performed.
reading.workResult_zh: 完成三个运行日已选对象的一手来源 Deep Reading，并形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。Q-20260810-01 核验了可恢复 RunState 的持久 Pending Input Admission，包括序列化 Pending Input、Occurrence Identity、Guardrail/Admission 顺序、已接纳响应与工具进度的 Checkpoint，以及 SDK 内部 Exactly-once 语义边界；Q-20260810-02 核验了 OrchestraBench 的受控故障注入设计、三层恢复行为、Blind Retry 对 Latent Mode 无效、Cascade Radius 随深度增长、Trusted-upstream 的策略假设、llm_noupstream 消融以及论文明确的外部有效性限制；Q-20260810-03 核验了 MCPServerManager 的竞态机制、Manager-level Lifecycle Serialization、Cancellation-shielded Cleanup Ownership、安全 Worker Replacement、Cleanup Failure 保留、默认 10 秒 Lifecycle Timeout 与确定性并发回归测试。未执行 Research Analysis 或文章写作。
